full_name: Kate Soper | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2012–2013 Arts The Carl and Lily Pforzheimer Foundation Fellow Columbia University
bio: Kate Soper is a composer and performer whose music explores the continuums of expressivity and intelligibility, the structures of drama and rhetoric, and the potential of the human voice to communicate abstractly. With experience in Western classical and Indian Carnatic music and experimental theater, she performs frequently as a new-music soprano. She is the managing director and vocalist for Wet Ink, a new-music ensemble dedicated to seeking out adventurous music across aesthetic boundaries.
